basic_details.job_title: MPPGCL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 10 Electrician, Fitter & Other Posts
basic_details.short_information: Madhya Pradesh Power Generating Company Limited (MPPGCL) has invited online applications for 10 ITI Apprentice vacancies across Electrician, Fitter, Diesel Mechanic, and Welder trades on a contract basis. The one-year apprenticeship training offers a stipend of Rs. 10,560 - 11,040 by post. Candidates possessing an ITI qualification in the relevant discipline can apply online through the prescribed apprenticeship portal. The last date to apply is 30 October 2026. Complete the qualification section by adding Technical and Educational details, select your trade preferences in the Preference section, and upload your photo, birth certificate, and signature in the fourth stage.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed ITI (NCVT/SCVT) in the relevant subject from government or non-government industrial training institutes, along with High School (10th standard) qualification. The minimum age of candidates must be 18 years as of 01/01/2026. The maximum age limit for general category candidates is 27 years. For Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer), an age relaxation of 05 years is applicable, and for Divyang (PwD) candidates, a relaxation of 10 years is applicable. Candidates who have already been registered for or undergone apprenticeship training previously in any establishment, or those who are not native residents of Madhya Pradesh, are not eligible to apply. Reservation is applicable for SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), EWS, and PwD candidates as per the amended rules of 2019 of the State Government of Madhya Pradesh. content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: The duration of the apprenticeship training is one year. No additional allowances or benefits are admissible.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MPPGCL ITI Apprentice
content_sections.text: Visit the official apprenticeship portal at www.apprenticeship.gov.in and click on Apprentices Menu to register. Fill in personal details (Name, Father's name, Mother's name, Gender, DOB, Aadhaar number, Category) matching your Aadhaar card, and enter contact details to obtain an email ID and password. Complete the qualification section by adding Technical and Educational details, select your trade preferences in the Preference section, and upload your photo, birth certificate, and signature in the fourth stage. Review your entered information on the final page, click Edit if changes are needed, and click Confirm to complete the registration. Log in using your registered E-mail ID and password, go to Establishment Search under Establishment Menu, search for the establishment "2x45 Megavatrani Awanti Bai Sagar Jal Vidyut Grih Bargi Nagar Jabalpur", click Apply, and submit your application with your registration number and date of birth.

faq.question: Q1. Is this a permanent job or a contract position?
faq.answer: This is a one-year apprenticeship training program under the Apprentices Act 1961, and employment after completion is not guaranteed by MPPGCL.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible to apply for these apprentice vacancies?
faq.answer: Native residents of Madhya Pradesh who have passed ITI in the relevant trade from NCVT or SCVT approved institutes can apply.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit online applications?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications through the portal is 30 October 2026 up to 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates selected for the ITI apprentice positions?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on the percentage of marks obtained in ITI and High School, followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly stipend provided during the training period?
faq.answer: The monthly stipend is Rs. 10,560 for one-year ITI courses and Rs. 11,040 for two-year ITI courses.
